attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Create a Pin System. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need. Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Spine_Inv_Jnt, Spine_F_Jnt.
